items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: In truth, all the male Partzufim of Atzilut are of the discernment of the new MA, even the first three Partzufim. However, since they did not come into Atzilut for their own need, this name rests only on ZA alone. And since the essential correction that was renewed in ZA is only the discernment of Yesod, as above in answers 90 and 88, only Yesod is defined by the name MA, which corrects BON, and on it rests the essential renewal of Atzilut. (p. 868, Item 8; p. 871, Item 15. And in Etz Chaim, Gate 9, Chapter 8. And above, p. 873, Item 20.) And see well above in answers 88, 89, and 90.
